title: Game Rule
description: Schema for defining game rules, including conditions and actions to modify the game state.

condition.description: Logical condition block to evaluate. Determines whether the rule's actions should be executed.

all.description: Array of conditions that must all evaluate to true (AND logic).

any.description: Array of conditions where at least one must evaluate to true (OR logic).

actions.description: Array of actions to execute if the condition evaluates to true.

conditionClause.description: Defines a single condition clause for evaluating the game state.

field.description: The field in the game state to evaluate.

operator.description: The comparison operator to use for evaluation.

value.description: The value to compare the field against. Can be a string, number, or boolean.

actionClause.description: Defines a single action to modify the game state.

type.description: The type of action to perform.

field.description: The field in the game state to modify (if applicable).

value.description: The value to set or add to the field (if applicable).

amount.description: The amount to increase or decrease a numeric field (if applicable).

target.description: The target entity or object for the action (if applicable).

category.description: The category of the action (if applicable).

flag.description: A flag to set or modify in the game state (if applicable).

clue.description: The clue to unlock (for unlockClue actions).

scene.description: The narrative scene to add (for addNarrative actions).
